sleepiest.speaker: wick
sleepiest.text: Well, if it isn't the sleepiest apprentice in the meadow.

dawn.speaker: wick
dawn.text: Bram's taking us both out at dawn. Try not to trip over your own tail.

choices.text: Says the cat who fell in the stream last moon.

fern_stream.speaker: fern
fern_stream.text: Says the cat who fell in the stream last moon.

smells_wrong.speaker: wick
smells_wrong.text: ...Fine. Maybe I didn't sleep last night either. The north edge smells wrong lately.

last_vole.speaker: wick
last_vole.text: Here. Last vole on the pile. The elders haven't eaten yet, but... nobody's counting.

our_secret.speaker: wick
our_secret.text: Ha. Knew you had some sense. Our secret.

repeat_shared.speaker: wick
repeat_shared.text: Did she like it? ...Don't tell her I asked.
